tecnicas.observacao: O prompt executado tem três etapas: analisar a tarefa (raciocinio; perguntas dirigidas sobre a abordagem algorítmica), planejar as etapas de codificação decompondo o problema em subproblemas (decomposicao) e gerar código Python 3 em formato Markdown (restricoes); a solicitação explícita e estruturada conta como instrucao. O caso de uso (Fig. 2) descreve geração e avaliação de hipóteses por nó e seleção do melhor ramo pelo próprio LLM, mas o artigo não informa se isso ocorre em chamadas separadas; as cinco chamadas à API servem para medir a variabilidade, não para seleção, por isso não se registrou amostragem. O texto completo do prompt não é apresentado. mecanismos_acrescentados vazio: nenhuma condição sem ToT foi executada; o artigo contrasta com o prompt zero-shot de outros estudos ([20], [3]), cujo conteúdo não descreve. Sem contrafactual executado: as comparações com Ouyang et al. [3] usam números de outro artigo.

citacoes.trecho: Our experiments on GPT-3.5 Turbo model using 829 code generation problems from benchmarks such as CodeContests, APPS (Automated Programming Progress Standard) and HumanEval demonstrate a substantial reduction in non-determinism compared to previous findings.

Unlike the standard methods of evaluating code generation by LLMs [20], where a simple zero-shot prompt is used, our ToT approach involves creating structured prompts in multiple steps to guide the LLM in generating correct and deterministic code.
citacoes.localizador: PDF p. 3, Seção III, 'Design of ToT Prompting'

citacoes.trecho: Step 2: Plan the coding steps in Python (breaking down the problem into sub-problems).
Step 3: Generate Python 3 code in Markdown format.
To enable ChatGPT to produce five distinct predictions from the same prompt, we perform five successive API calls.
For each node, the LLM generates multiple hypotheses or potential solutions.

Despite recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) for code generation, their inherent non-determinism remains a significant obstacle for reliable and reproducible software engineering research.
Non-deterministically generated code may contain errors, inconsistencies, or inefficiencies, limiting its practical utility [6].
Temperature=2 leads to a sharp decline in test pass rates with an extremely low average, suggesting that increasing the temperature significantly hinders ChatGPT’s ability to generate correct code.
A temperature of 0 promotes accuracy, similarity, and determinism, while a temperature of 2 leads to excessive creativity that hinders the quality and similarity of the generated code.

To ensure that test cases are executed sequentially and to prevent concurrency issues that could arise from simultaneous executions, we use scripts called monothread (instructions are executed in the order they are written).
citacoes.localizador: PDF p. 3, Seção III, 'Test Case Execution'

citacoes.trecho: These results show a drastic reduction in semantic variability for the CodeContests and APPS datasets compared to the results of Ouyang and al. [3] which show percentages of 72.73%; 60.40% for the same datasets.

For HumanEval, the reduction in semantic variability is less pronounced (from 65.85% to 69%), which may indicate that the tasks in this dataset present unique challenges that are not fully mitigated by TOT.

Table II shows percentages of coding tasks without a single identical test output among the five different requests of 4.32%; 9%; and 69% for the CodeContests, APPS, and HumanEval datasets, respectively.
Due to the limited financial resources (300 $) available for this work, we only present the results for the APPS dataset, with which we were able to experiment with all temperature values.
Nevertheless, our observation indicates that the top five candidate codes from a single request (R1) have very similar similarities to the top five candidates from multiple requests (R2).
The original test set contains 5,000 problems, and we randomly sample 500 problems.

extracoes.selecao_motivo: Sem principal declarado: o resumo destaca ToT e a redução de tarefas com saídas inconsistentes, mas a condição comparadora são 'previous findings' de outro artigo, não condição executada, e o método apresenta várias métricas sem que uma prevaleça. Sem contraste executado, aplicou-se a ordem à extração descritiva: primeira tabela de resultados (Table II), primeira métrica (Test pass rate, Mean), único modelo, primeiro benchmark na ordem das colunas (CodeContests).
